They ring as usual, with a label.
Suspicious means a spoofed number or a one-ring call from abroad. Carrier and region are looked up on your phone in the Russian numbering registry from %1$s. Numbers never leave your phone.
Suspicious means a spoofed number or a one-ring call from abroad. Carrier and region are looked up on your phone. Numbers never leave your phone.
Yandex, Kaspersky Who Calls and others show their own card over the call. Pick one under «Caller ID & spam app».
Want Yandex caller ID too? Install the Yandex app, then pick it under «Caller ID & spam app». Both protections work together.
The number database is over 3 months old, so numbers missing from it are only labelled: they may simply be new. It updates with the app.
